LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneNamed: {GOD} has gone from the land as quietly as it came.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Harmed: {HARMER}'s blow landed, and {STRANGER} straightened under it, and grew, and was not a {TRAVELLER} at all. Everyone near saw its face, and the light went wrong.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_TurnedAway: Out on the road, the {TRAVELLER} the colony turned away stopped and looked back. For a moment it stood taller than the trees, and the light went strange. "Another time," it said.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Poor: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped and turned, and for a moment was something far older than a {TRAVELLER}. It looked back at the colony a long while, and said nothing at all.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Fair: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped and turned, and stood taller than the wall, bright as noon. "I'll know the way here," it said.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Kind: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped and turned, and grew, while everyone watched, into something with a light coming off it like heat off a hearth. It laughed, a sound like a door opening.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Plain_Generous: At the gate {STRANGER} stopped and turned, and grew into something taller than the wall, bright as a fire on a winter night. It put a hand on the gatepost as it went.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Harmed: One moment {STRANGER} was there, struck and bleeding. The next there was nobody, and the air smelled of a lightning strike.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_TurnedAway: The {TRAVELLER} the colony turned away is gone. Nobody saw them reach the edge of the land.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Poor: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} is gone, and nobody saw them leave the land.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Fair: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} is gone, and nobody saw them leave the land. Everyone who talked with them remembers the talk a little differently.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Kind: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} was gone before anyone was up. Nobody saw them leave, and nobody heard the gate.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Veiled_Generous: The {TRAVELLER} {STRANGER} was gone before anyone was up. Nobody heard the gate, and the animals never stirred.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_LookedAt: {KINDEST} can't stop thinking about the last look it gave them.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Harmed: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was struck
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_TurnedAway: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was turned away
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Poor: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was poorly kept
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Fair: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was fairly kept
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Kind: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was kindly kept
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Stranger_Act_Generous: came to the gate as a {TRAVELLER}, and was welcomed like family
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Memory_Stranger: the {TRAVELLER} who came to the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Gift: Something happened when the stranger looked at me, and I can't put it into words.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Out_Fever: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with a fever.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_LateGift: Something has been left at the gate of {HOME} in the night, and nobody saw who left it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Omen_Dream: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} woke from the same dream: "{DREAM}"
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Rising_Text: At the edge of {HOME}'s land the ground broke, and roots drew themselves up out of it into a shape taller than any tree: bark and moss, and a knot in the wood where a face would be. It stands there, quite still.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Memory_Rising: the roots that rose out of the ground
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Surfaced_Text: Out in the wet ground near {HOME}, something surfaced: a {BEAST}, mottled and very old, with eyes like wet stones. It is looking at the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Surfaced_Act: surfaced from the wet ground as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_StoneFell: Loose stone came down in the deep workings and struck {PAWN_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Woken_Text: Deep under {HOME} the rock gave way and the deep working closed. Then the mountainside split, and something came up out of it: red and black, larger than a house, with smoke at its teeth and heat coming off it like a forge. It is looking at the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Woken_Act: came up out of the mountain
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Woken_Gone: The dragon from under the mountain is gone.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Memory_Woken: the thing that came up out of the mountain
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Quake_Text: Deep under {HOME} the rock gave way and the deep working closed. The whole mountain shook, and a shadow far larger than any cloud crossed the land.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_Text: A {BEAST} has come in from the edge of the land, larger than any of its kind, with a light about it that the dusk doesn't dim. It looks at the colony as if it has been here before.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_TextKin: A {BEAST} has come in from the edge of the land, larger than any of its kind, pale and lit from within. Others of its kind follow a long way behind it, and keep their distance.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Boon_Text: {PAWN_nameDef} followed the {BEAST} across the land, and it looked back now and then to see that {PAWN_pronoun} still came. Then it stopped.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Boon_Vein: It stopped by a seam of {ORE} in the rock that nobody had seen before.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_LedAct: led {PAWN} out across the land as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Memory_Animal: the {BEAST} that was more than a beast
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Led: I followed the {BEAST} today, and I don't know how to say what it was.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Sat_Nothing: I sat near the {BEAST} while it grazed. I don't know what I expected.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Sat_Grief: I sat near the {BEAST} a long while today. When I got up, the grief I carry was lighter.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Sat_Fear: I sat near the {BEAST} today, and the fear I've always had doesn't seem to be there anymore.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Sat_Passion: I sat near the {BEAST} today, and all I could think about was {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Sat_Horn: I touched the {BEAST}'s horn today. It let me. It was warm.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Sacrilege_Text: {HARMER} drew blood from the {BEAST}. It turned and looked at the colony, and nobody moved.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Sacrilege_TextSlain: {HARMER} brought the {BEAST} down. As it fell, the light went out of it, and nobody moved.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_KinStruck_Text: {HARMER} hurt one of the {KIN}s following the {BEAST}. The {BEAST} turned its great head and looked at the colony for a long moment.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_HurtAct: was hurt by {PAWN} while it walked the land as a {BEAST}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_KinHurtAct: saw one of its {KIN}s hurt by {PAWN}
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_Gone: The {BEAST} has gone from the land as quietly as it came.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneHurt: The wounded {BEAST} is gone, and nobody saw where.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Animal_GoneSpurned: The {BEAST} would not be kept, and is gone.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Menu_Hurt: it was hurt, and won't come near anyone
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Menu_NoFood: nothing in the stores a {KIND} would eat
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Job_Horn: reaching up to touch the {KIND}'s horn.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_MarkAct: At {HOME}, people began to speak of the place where it happened.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Journal_Mark: I went out to the place where they say {GOD} {WHAT}, and stood there a while.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Birds: {WHO} saw every bird on the land around {HOME} take off at once and fly away.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Calm: {WHO} felt the wind die at {HOME}, and nothing moved for a long while.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Candle: {WHO} watched a light at {HOME} go out again and again with no draft to blow it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Restless: {WHO} saw the animals at {HOME} start and run, then stand all looking the same way.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Dream: {WHO} and {OTHER} woke from the same dream at {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Drift: {WHO} saw every leaf and seed on the land drift toward one place, on no wind.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_AnimaHum: {WHO} heard the anima tree humming, loud enough to hear indoors.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_DryadsStill: {WHO} saw the dryads stop what they were doing and stand still, all facing one way.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Shadow: {WHO} saw a shadow with wings cross the whole land at noon, and the grass flatten under its wind.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Steam: {WHO} saw steam come up out of the ground at {HOME}, warm as breath.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Rumble: {WHO} felt the rock rumble overhead in the deep workings, and dust came down.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_FairyRing: {WHO} found a ring of mushrooms at {HOME} that had come up overnight.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Earth: {WHO} smelled wet earth on the air at {HOME}, though no rain had fallen.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Threads: {WHO} found fine white threads across a floor at {HOME} where there had been none.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Flicker: {WHO} watched the lights at {HOME} flicker in a pattern, over and over.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Static: {WHO} heard something in the comms console's static that sounded almost like a voice.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Unpowered: {WHO} saw a light at {HOME} glowing with no power to it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_VastShadow: {WHO} saw a shadow far too large for any cloud drift across the land at noon.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Star: {WHO} watched a star move the wrong way across the night sky.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_FrostWriting: {WHO} saw frost by a wall at {HOME} in lines that looked like writing.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Silence: {WHO} heard everything at {HOME} go silent at once, and everyone stopped where they stood.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_WhiteFigure: {WHO} saw a tall white figure at the edge of the land in the dark, and it wasn't there when they looked again.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Dark: {WHO} saw a dark at {HOME} that the light didn't reach.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Whisper: {WHO} says a sweet voice spoke to them at {HOME} when nobody was near.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Croak: {WHO} heard a deep croaking come up out of the wet ground at {HOME}, felt more than heard.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StillSun: {WHO} saw the sun stand still over {HOME} a long while, and the shadows didn't move.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_HeatHaze: {WHO} watched the air shimmer over the open ground at {HOME} in the noon heat.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_BigMoon: {WHO} saw the moon come up huge and close over {HOME}, and stay there all night.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Glint: {WHO} caught a glint of gold out of the corner of their eye, and nothing was there.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Beetle: {WHO} watched a golden beetle walk across a table at {HOME} and off the edge.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Coin: {WHO} found a gold coin at their feet at {HOME} where nobody had dropped one.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Rain: {WHO} watched the rain come to {HOME} and was sure it meant something.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Thunder: {WHO} heard the thunder over {HOME} and swore there were words in it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Eclipse: {WHO} saw the sun go dark over {HOME} and took it for anger.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Aurora: {WHO} watched the night sky over {HOME} light up and took it for a gift.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Cold: {WHO} felt the cold come down hard on {HOME} and said it wasn't natural.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Snow: {WHO} watched the snow fall on {HOME} and said it came for a reason.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Heat: {WHO} felt the heat come down on {HOME} like a stare and said so.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Clear: {WHO} looked up at the clear sky over {HOME} and called it a blessing.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Weather_Sleepless: {WHO} woke from a nightmare at {HOME} and swears the moon was watching.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_Found: {WHO} woke at {HOME} to find something left by their bed.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_FoundSeen: {WHO}, awake in the night at {HOME}, saw moonlight on something by {DOER}'s bed that wasn't there before.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_GoodDream: {WHO} woke at {HOME} from a good dream and kept smiling all morning.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_GoodDreamSeen: {WHO} heard {DOER} laughing in their sleep at {HOME}, under a bright moon.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_Healed: {WHO} woke at {HOME} to find their wound far better than it had any right to be.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_HealedSeen: {WHO} sat up with {DOER} at {HOME} and watched their wound look better by the hour.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_Nightmare: {WHO} woke at {HOME} from a nightmare that wouldn't let go.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_NightmareSeen: {WHO} heard {DOER} cry out in their sleep at {HOME}, under the moon.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_Frost: {WHO} woke at {HOME} to a hard frost all about where they sleep, and nowhere else.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_FrostSeen: {WHO} saw frost creep over the ground about where {DOER} sleeps, in the night at {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_AnimalBack: {WHO} woke at {HOME} to an animal standing at their door, looking in.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_AnimalBackSeen: {WHO} saw an animal come and stand at {DOER}'s door in the night at {HOME}, looking in.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_FoundAgain: It happened to {DOER} at {HOME} again in the night: this time something was left by their bed.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_GoodDreamAgain: It happened to {DOER} at {HOME} again in the night: this time a good dream they couldn't stop smiling about.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_HealedAgain: It happened to {DOER} at {HOME} again in the night: this time their wound was far better by morning.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_NightmareAgain: It happened to {DOER} at {HOME} again in the night: a nightmare, worse than the last.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_FrostAgain: It happened to {DOER} at {HOME} again in the night: this time a hard frost about where they sleep, and nowhere else.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Return_AnimalBackAgain: It happened to {DOER} at {HOME} again in the night: this time an animal came and stood at their door, looking in.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StrangerTell: {WHO} heard the {TRAVELLER} at the gate say something no traveller could have known.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StrangerKnewDead: {WHO} heard the {TRAVELLER} at the gate speak of {LOST} by name, and nobody had told it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StrangerShown: {WHO} saw the {TRAVELLER} who came to {HOME} turn at the gate and become something else.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StrangerGone: {WHO} says the {TRAVELLER} who came to {HOME} was more than a traveller, and nobody saw them go.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StrangerStruckShown: {WHO} saw {HARMER} strike the {TRAVELLER} at {HOME}, and saw it straighten and grow into something else.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_StrangerStruckGone: {WHO} saw {HARMER} strike the {TRAVELLER} at {HOME}, and swears it was gone the next moment.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_LateGift: {WHO} found something left at the gate of {HOME}, and nobody knew who left it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Animal: {WHO} saw a {BEAST} come onto the land at {HOME}, larger than any of its kind, with a light about it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_AnimalKin: {WHO} saw a {BEAST} come onto the land at {HOME}, with others of its kind following at a distance.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_AnimalGone: {WHO} watched the {BEAST} go its way from {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_AnimalGoneHurt: {WHO} saw the wounded {BEAST} leave {HOME}, and nobody saw where it went.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Fed: {WHO} took food out to the {BEAST}, and it ate.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Led: {WHO} followed the {BEAST} out across the land until it stopped and looked back.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Sat: {WHO} sat near the {BEAST} a long while as it grazed.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Horn: {WHO} touched the {BEAST}'s horn, and it let them.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Stare: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} follow {NAME} about, staring, as if she knew what they were.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Struck: {WHO} saw {HARMER} draw blood from the {BEAST}, and everything went quiet.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Slain: {WHO} saw the {BEAST} fall, and the light go out of it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_KinStruck: {WHO} saw {HARMER} hurt one of the {KIN}s that followed the {BEAST}, and the {BEAST} turned and looked.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Surfaced: {WHO} saw a {BEAST} surface from the wet ground at {HOME} and look at the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Rising: {WHO} saw roots break out of the ground at {HOME} and draw themselves up into a shape taller than any tree.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Woken: {WHO} saw the mountain at {HOME} split, and something red and black come up out of it.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Quake: {WHO} felt the whole mountain at {HOME} shake, and saw a vast shadow cross the land.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_StrangerAtGate: {STRANGER}, a {TRAVELLER}, is waiting at the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_StrangerByGate: {STRANGER}, a {TRAVELLER}, is sleeping by the gate
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Week_StrangerSub: a stranger who asked for shelter
